  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "explanation":"stolen_card",
      "likelihood":"high",
      "reasoning":"The issuing-country/IP mismatch combined with failed address verification supports card misuse. Failed issuer/identity verification strengthens this explanation, although it does not independently prove the fraud mechanism."
    },
    {
      "explanation":"traveller",
      "likelihood":"low",
      "reasoning":"Legitimate travel could explain the foreign IP, and address verification can fail on legitimate purchases. The failed identity check materially weakens this benign explanation."

  ],
  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"Only R03 holds, establishing the Card family. No other rule holds, no household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Row §6.6(b) applies, but the failed id_check decides immediately under §5.3(b): recommend decline. Escalation is prohibited because Linkage is absent. The order has already shipped, so the loss stands; decline blocks the account. Travel and an ordinary address-verification failure remain plausible benign explanations, but they do not override failed verification. No further check is needed."
